ModMetaData.name: Tribal Outfits [Star Sky Mods]
ModMetaData.author: chupakobra6 | Star Sky Mods
ModMetaData.description: Dress a RimWorld tribe for the desert, winter, a hunt or a fight. Tribal Outfits adds seven craftable sets with 26 pieces of apparel and a jade-tipped shaman staff Made at the request of svg FEATURES • Everyday leather – a leather hood and light moccasins • Desert – a wrap, thobe and sandals that help pawns cope with heat • Winter – a coat, hat, mittens and felt boots crafted from wool. The coat is warmer than a vanilla parka of the same material and quality • Barbarian – a leather cloak, helmet and tunic that raise the pain shock threshold. Hand wraps increase bow firing rate and melee hit chance. Foot wraps improve hunting stealth • Shaman – devilstrand and jade apparel plus a wooden staff with a jade tip. Both boost psychic sensitivity, with stronger bonuses at higher quality • Hive – armor that protects against sharp and blunt damage. Craft it from chitin when Alpha Animals or Insectoids 2 is enabled, or from leather with neither active • Steel Monsters – recon-style armor made with plasteel, leather and mechanoid slag chunks Each pair of footwear adds 0.10 cells per second to movement speed. Footwear pieces share the same layer HOW TO USE Choose a recipe at a Crafting Spot, tailoring bench or smithy. Each piece is crafted separately. Recipes require up to level 5 Crafting, depending on the set. No research is required Steel Monsters armor uses the base game’s mechanoid slag chunks. Look for them among the remains of mechanoids and in ruins. The same chunks can still be smelted for steel COMPATIBILITY Requires RimWorld 1.6 and Harmony (https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2009463077). Includes English and Russian text Alpha Animals (https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1541721856) and Vanilla Factions Expanded – Insectoids 2 (https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3309003431) are optional sources of chitin. With Royalty enabled, shaman equipment also improves neural heat recovery FEEDBACK Found a bug?
